content_sections.heading: CVRDE Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed out from an ITI duly recognized by NCVT/SCVT, as per the Gazette Notification of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, in a trade of minimum two years' duration - except for Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA), Painter, Plumber, Welder, and Food Production, which are exempt from this two-year duration requirement. Only candidates who completed the qualifying examination as regular candidates are eligible; private candidates are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: CVRDE Age Limit (as on 01-09-2026)
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age - Unreserved (UR): 27 years Maximum age - OBC: 30 years Maximum age - SC/ST: 32 years Maximum age - PWD: 37 years Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: CVRDE Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination, followed by a Walk-In Interview. Selected candidates will be given their joining letter on the spot at CVRDE, Avadi, Chennai-600054. It is clarified that no employment is guaranteed to apprentices on completion of their training, as selection and training are strictly under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961. Additional eligibility notes: only candidates who passed the qualifying exam in 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible - those who passed earlier than 2023 are not eligible. Candidates whose results were not declared by 30-08-2026 will not be considered for training, though a provisional certificate is acceptable at the time of joining, with the final NCVT/SCVT certificate to be submitted later. Expired OBC certificates will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for the CVRDE Walk-In Interview
content_sections.text: 10th or 12th mark sheet and certificate ITI mark sheets and NCVT/SCVT certificate Caste certificate, if applicable Aadhaar Card NCVT/SCVT MIS portal registration number (mandatory, verified at the time of walk-in interview/document verification)

content_sections.heading: How to Attend the CVRDE Walk-In Interview
content_sections.text: Complete mandatory registration on the NCVT/SCVT MIS portal at https://ncvtmis.gov.in and note the registration number. Report to the CVRDE, Avadi, Chennai-600054 venue on 08-09-2026 or 09-09-2026, between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM. Carry all required original documents along with photocopies for verification, including the NCVT/SCVT registration number. Candidates will be shortlisted on the spot based on ITI marks and interviewed the same day. Candidates will be informed of their selection status on the spot, and selected candidates will receive their joining letter immediately. No separate application form submission, online portal, or fee payment process is specified in the notification beyond the NCVT/SCVT registration requirement.

content_sections.heading: CVRDE Recruitment 2026 – Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Duration of training will strictly follow the Apprentices Act, 1961, the Apprenticeship Rules, and their amendments from time to time. No employment is guaranteed to apprentices on completion of their training. If any information or document is found false or forged at any stage, the candidature or appointment will be withdrawn immediately without assigning any reason. Selected candidates must produce a valid police verification certificate at the time of joining, from their place of last residence or permanent address.

faq.question: Q1. What is CVRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a Walk-In Interview recruitment by the Combat Vehicles Research & Development Establishment (CVRDE), DRDO, for 93 ITI Apprentice Trainee posts across 18 trades, under Advt No. CVRDE/ADMIN/2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CVRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 93 vacancies (indicative) across 18 ITI trades, with the largest number in Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (13) and Electrician (12).

faq.question: Q3. When is the CVRDE Walk-In Interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 08-09-2026 and 09-09-2026, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, at CVRDE, Avadi, Chennai-600054.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CVRDE Apprentice Trainee posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI from an NCVT/SCVT-recognized institute, in a trade of minimum two years' duration, except for COPA, Painter, Plumber, Welder, and Food Production, which don't require this duration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CVRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01-09-2026, the minimum age is 18 years, and the maximum age is 27 years (UR), 30 years (OBC), 32 years (SC/ST), and 37 years (PWD).

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for CVRDE ITI Apprentice Trainees?
faq.answer: The stipend is either ₹10,560 or ₹11,040 per month, depending on the trade.

faq.question: Q7. Is prior online application required for CVRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No separate application submission is specified - candidates must complete mandatory registration on the NCVT/SCVT MIS portal (ncvtmis.gov.in) and then attend the walk-in interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CVRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through shortlisting based on ITI marks, followed by a walk-in interview. Selected candidates receive their joining letter on the spot.

faq.question: Q9. Which candidates are eligible based on passing year?
faq.answer: Only candidates who passed their qualifying ITI examination in 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible; those who passed before 2023 are not eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Is employment guaranteed after the CVRDE apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. The notification explicitly states that no employment is guaranteed to apprentices on completion of their training, as the engagement is strictly under the Apprentices Act, 1961.
